items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 55:1
items.html: (To the question) At the time the GAR of Nekudim came out, AVI were in the aspect of back to back, so there was no expansion from them to a body. Therefore they needed the coupling of AB and SAG, and the MAN of the Yesod of AK, and then they came into a coupling of face to face, and expanded into their bodies, which are the seven Kings. (p. 548, Item 6)
